assets.prompt: Cinematic key art for a AAA mystery adventure game. A lone granite lighthouse tower, one hundred and twelve feet, standing on a wave-broken reef nine miles offshore under a bruised late-October dusk. Its lantern is DARK — no beam. In the near foreground, out of focus, the slate roofline and chimney stacks of a Victorian records fortress on a headland, one small window lit warm amber. Cold Atlantic swell, spindrift, low ragged cloud, a last cold band of dying light on the horizon. Deep teal and slate blues against a single warm amber accent. Painterly digital oil painting, visible confident brushwork, dramatic chiaroscuro, atmospheric depth haze, cinematic wide composition with generous empty sky in the upper third for a title to sit. Moody, lonely, forensic. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no signatures, no watermarks, no logos, no UI elements, no borders or frames, no people, no boats.

A soft black radial vignette on a pure white background, heavy darkening at the four corners fading smoothly to clear white at the centre, very gradual falloff, no hard edge, no banding. Pure greyscale gradient only. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no objects, no watermarks, no borders.

A seamless flat scan of an aged nautical chart paper, pale bone-grey stock with a faint blue-grey cast, fine fibre grain, soft water staining and foxing toward one edge, subtle fold creases. Evenly lit, completely flat, no shadows, no printed content. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no lines, no compass rose, no coastlines, no watermarks, no borders.
